signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Work directly with Chalk’s VP of Product and co-founders to define and execute product priorities
Develop a clear understanding of user needs across data and AI/ML teams; translate customer feedback into product requirements
Drive end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, including scoping, milestones, project management, and release coordination
Partner deeply with engineering on technically complex areas (developer experience, performance, reliability, integrations)
Write product specifications and make tradeoffs aligned with business outcomes and customer impact
